plugins.name: annetaan
plugins.description: Claude Code skills from Annetaan Inc. Holds workflow, which runs one implementation as design, per-task implement and review rounds, an integration review when there is more than one task, and a finish step that resolves any conflict with the base under review, opens a pull request and files an issue for each design decision a person should read, all in a worktree of its own. It also resolves the conflicts of a pull request that is already open, when you ask in plain words. Also pj1-plan, pj2-issues, pj3-doctor and pj4-running, which run a larger piece of work as projects on GitHub. pj1-plan cuts the work into projects with the dependencies between them, and pj2-issues splits one project into tasks, one sub-issue each, once the projects it waits on are merged. From there the work goes through decisions you tick on GitHub and pj3-doctor's review of the whole project to one merged pull request per sub-issue through pj4-running, and a pull request that brings the whole project back for you to merge. pj-auto drives pj3-doctor and pj4-running on a project until it needs you, and pj-cleanup closes the project, removes its worktree and branch, and brings your branch up to date once you have merged it, and cleanup does the same for a workflow run or a level or pj-roadmap proposal. pj-roadmap brings the repository's roadmap file into the format the pj skills read, through a pull request. And level, which proposes how much model the design, the implementation and the review get in this repository, from the review counts of merged pull requests and the code, through a pull request. And doc-write, which writes a document in plain words that says each thing once and in order, and doc-meta, doc-review and doc-revise, which let you flag sentences in a document with an opinion and have the document revised to match. And experience-video, which interviews you about your customer's experience and renders a video of under one minute from it. And pr-humans, which records on a pull request, open or closed, how people took part in it. Skills: workflow, cleanup, pj1-plan, pj2-issues, pj3-doctor, pj4-running, pj-auto, pj-cleanup, pj-roadmap, level, doc-write, doc-meta, doc-review, doc-revise, experience-video, pr-humans.
